questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

This question probes ability to design production-grade NLP with calibration, drift detection, and safe decision-making in a multilingual, real-time setting—covering metrics, monitoring, and rollout safety.

## Key Concepts

- Confidence calibration per language
- Real-time drift detection (KL divergence, PSI)
- Fairness and bias monitoring across languages
- Safe routing (auto-respond vs escalation)
- A/B testing and rollback safety
- Audit logging and explainability

## Code Example

```javascript
function calibrate(scores, temperature) {
  // temperature scaling example
  const z = scores.map(s => Math.exp(s / temperature));
  const sum = z.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);
  return z.map(v => v/sum);
}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you measure calibration quality over time?
- What thresholds would you tune for low-resource languages?
- How would you implement a rollback if the auto-response quality drops?

## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design a complete, production-grade NLP system that handles multilingual data, live updates, and strict privacy/governance constraints. It also probes integration of limited-resource models, knowledge graphs, and drift-aware deployment.

## Key Concepts
- Streaming NLP with end-to-end EL/IE across EN/ES/ZH
- Cross-language entity linking to a semantic knowledge graph
- Privacy: differential privacy during learning and on-place data handling
- Drift detection: KL-divergence, ensemble checks, canary rollouts
- Governance: rollout/rollback, provenance auditing

## Code Example
```python
def update_kg_with_event(kg, ent, rel, src):
    kg.add_node(ent, label=rel, provenance=src)
    kg.add_relation( ent, rel, src )
```
## Follow-up Questions
- How would you evaluate drift per language and per data source?
- What rollback criteria and metrics would you publish to stakeholders?

```python
    id = lang_id(text)
    toks = tokenize(text, lang=id)
    tags = model.predict(toks)
    ents = extract_entities(tags, toks)
    return ents
```
